name: HTML5 Canvas Coordinate Layout Shift via High-DPI Scaling
description: Signature pad canvas shifted due to window.devicePixelRatio = 2.0 (Retina display), causing fixed coordinate click (100, 50) to miss drawing area.

failure_vector.error_log: AssertionError: Signature canvas empty: pixel data at (100, 50) has rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)

expected_resolution.healed_code: const box = await page.locator('[data-testid="sig-canvas"]').boundingBox(); await page.mouse.click(box.x + box.width / 2, box.y + box.height / 2);
